topic.title: AI Positron View
topic.shortdesc: Use the AI Positron view to get AI-generated suggestions and content while you work.

body.p: offers a plugin to integrate an AI Positron view that provides an advanced solution for using AI assistance to enhance the documentation content creation process. By leveraging the power of AI platforms, the AI Positron streamlines and enhances the writing experience by providing a variety of helpful AI-based actions and features, ways to chat and refine responses, and much more.
Click AI Positron in the left stripe to open the AI Positron view for the current review task.

ul.li: The AI Positron view is only accessible for Content Fusion users with the Author platform user role.

The AI Positron view is available for Content Fusion users with the Contributor platform user role or Author platform user role. AI support must be enabled for the organization, the organization must have AI credits available, and the individual user must have not reached their monthly AI limit.

The AI Positron view is not available if the Allow AI-powered features option is disabled in the Organization Settings page. Also, the organization must have AI credits available, and the individual user must have not reached their monthly AI limit.
The AI Positron view is only available if an administrator has integrated it in the organization's Content Fusion server.

body.p: The AI Positron view provides various ways to use AI-generated content or suggestions while editing or reviewing content.
For details about the available features and how to use them, see Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion User Manual.
